title: Webhook Triggers Settings
description: Trigger external webhooks from YouTrack events. Each trigger is one endpoint: pick the event, enter the URL, and set the token sent with that endpoint's requests. Add a trigger with event "All events" to fan out to every event type.

headerName.title: Header name
headerName.description: The HTTP header name that carries each trigger's token in outgoing requests

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: One row per webhook endpoint. Each row has its own token, so a compromised endpoint never exposes the others. At most 10 endpoints are called for any single event; beyond that the extra rows for that event are skipped and a warning is logged.

event.title: Event
event.description: The YouTrack event that fires this webhook

url.title: URL
url.description: The webhook endpoint. HTTPS strongly recommended — the token is sent with every request.

secret.title: Token
secret.description: Shared secret sent to this endpoint in the configured header. Must be at least 32 characters long. Rotate immediately if the endpoint is decommissioned or a compromise is suspected.
